pack.name: CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark
pack.description: CIS-aligned Azure hardening themes for architecture review. Not CIS benchmark pass/fail.

rules.title: MFA enforced for privileged Azure AD roles
rules.description: Global Administrator and other privileged Entra roles must document MFA enforcement — not password-only administrative access.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record MFA policy in governance.RequiredControls; cite Conditional Access and privileged role assignments from azureExtractor when present.

frameworkMappings.theme: CIS 1.1 — Ensure MFA enabled for privileged users

rules.title: MFA enforced for all non-privileged users
rules.description: Standard user access to Azure and integrated SaaS should require MFA or federated equivalent for interactive sessions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document user MFA baseline in governance.PolicyConstraints; tag identity-dependent services with mfa:required in services[].Tags.

frameworkMappings.theme: CIS 1.2 — Ensure MFA enabled for all users

rules.title: Guest users reviewed and restricted
rules.description: B2B guest accounts must be inventoried with justification, expiration, and least-privilege group membership.
rules.remediationGuidance: List guest-access patterns in metadata.ChangeDescription; align guest inventory with azureExtractor Entra exports.

rules.title: Security defaults or Conditional Access baseline
rules.description: Tenant must document whether Security Defaults or explicit Conditional Access policies provide baseline sign-in protection.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture CA policy themes in governance.RequiredControls and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: User consent to applications restricted
rules.description: Enterprise applications and OAuth consent policies must prevent unreviewed third-party application access to tenant data.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document consent restrictions in governance.PolicyConstraints; enumerate high-risk app integrations on services[].Tags.

frameworkMappings.theme: CIS 1.5 — Restrict user consent to apps

rules.title: Storage account public access disabled
rules.description: Blob and file endpoints must not allow anonymous public read unless explicitly approved with compensating monitoring.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag storage services with public-access:disabled; verify allowBlobPublicAccess false in azureExtractor storage inventory.

rules.title: Storage encryption at rest enabled
rules.description: All storage accounts and managed disks must document platform or customer-managed encryption with no legacy unencrypted tiers.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record encryption expectations in governance.RequiredControls and datastores[].Tags; cite SSE settings from extractor.

rules.title: Storage soft delete and versioning for critical data
rules.description: Production data stores should document soft delete, versioning, or snapshot policies protecting against accidental or malicious deletion.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe retention protections in governance.PolicyConstraints and datastores[].Tags.

rules.title: Storage network rules restrict public endpoints
rules.description: Storage accounts holding sensitive data should use private endpoints or restricted network ACLs — not open internet access.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document network restrictions in governance.RequiredControls; align with azureExtractor private endpoint inventory.

rules.title: SQL auditing and threat detection enabled
rules.description: Azure SQL and managed instances must document auditing, Advanced Threat Protection, or equivalent detective controls.
rules.remediationGuidance: List SQL audit destinations in governance.RequiredControls; cite server/database audit settings from azureExtractor.

rules.title: SQL TDE enabled for databases
rules.description: Transparent Data Encryption must be documented for all SQL databases storing confidential or regulated data.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag SQL datastores with tde:enabled; reference encryption state in datastores[].Tags and azureExtractor SQL inventory.

rules.title: SQL public network access restricted
rules.description: Database servers should disable public endpoint access or restrict to approved IP ranges and private link only.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document SQL connectivity model in governance.PolicyConstraints; verify publicNetworkAccess settings in extractor output.

rules.title: Key Vault soft delete and purge protection
rules.description: Key Vault instances storing production keys must document soft delete and purge protection to prevent irreversible key loss or theft.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record Key Vault hardening in governance.RequiredControls; cite vault properties from azureExtractor.

rules.title: Key Vault network access restricted
rules.description: Secrets and keys should be reachable only from approved VNets or private endpoints — not the public internet.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe Key Vault network ACLs in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Diagnostic settings enabled for platform logs
rules.description: Activity logs and resource diagnostic settings must route to Log Analytics, Storage, or SIEM with stated retention.
rules.remediationGuidance: Enumerate diagnostic destinations in governance.RequiredControls; map log-enabled resources from azureExtractor.

rules.title: Activity log retention meets policy minimum
rules.description: Subscription activity logs must be retained for the period required by security and compliance policies — not left at default only.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document retention in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Network WAF enabled for internet-facing apps
rules.description: Application Gateway WAF or Front Door WAF must protect public HTTP(S) entry points with managed rule sets.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag internet-facing services with waf:enabled; document WAF mode (prevention/detection) in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: NSG rules follow least privilege
rules.description: Network security groups must document default-deny posture with explicit allow rules — no overly broad 0.0.0.0/0 management ports.
rules.remediationGuidance: Review NSG narratives in metadata.ChangeDescription; align with azureExtractor NSG rule inventory.

rules.title: Just-in-time VM access for management ports
rules.description: Administrative access to VMs should use JIT or bastion patterns — not permanently open RDP/SSH from the internet.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document JIT/bastion approach in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Managed disks encrypted
rules.description: VM and scale-set disks must use encrypted managed disks with platform or customer-managed keys.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag compute services with disk-encryption posture; cite disk encryption settings from azureExtractor.

rules.title: Azure Defender / Microsoft Defender for Cloud enabled
rules.description: Subscriptions should document Defender plans enabled for servers, containers, SQL, and storage as risk warrants.
rules.remediationGuidance: List Defender plan coverage in governance.ComplianceTags and governance.RequiredControls.

frameworkMappings.theme: CIS 2.1 — Microsoft Defender for Cloud enabled

rules.title: Auto provisioning of monitoring agents documented
rules.description: VM and Arc-enabled servers should document agent deployment for vulnerability and configuration assessment.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe agent deployment in metadata.ChangeDescription; align with azureExtractor extension inventory.

rules.title: Email security for Exchange Online (if in scope)
rules.description: When M365 email is in architecture scope, anti-phishing and safe attachments policies must be referenced.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document email security controls in governance.PolicyConstraints when Exchange Online appears in services[].

rules.title: App Service authentication enabled where applicable
rules.description: Public App Services must document authentication/authorization (Easy Auth, App Gateway, API Management) before business data exposure.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag App Service auth mode on services[].Tags; record identity integration in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: App Service HTTPS only and TLS minimum
rules.description: Web apps must enforce HTTPS-only and TLS 1.2+ with deprecated cipher suites disabled.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document TLS minimums in governance.PolicyConstraints; verify httpsOnly and minTlsVersion in azureExtractor App Service settings.

frameworkMappings.theme: CIS 9.3 — App Service TLS and HTTPS

rules.title: Container registry admin user disabled
rules.description: ACR must use managed identity or service principal pull — not enabled admin account for routine operations.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record ACR auth model in governance.RequiredControls; cite adminUserEnabled false in extractor registry inventory.

rules.title: Kubernetes API server access restricted
rules.description: AKS API server should be private or authorized-IP restricted with documented break-glass access.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document API server access profile in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Subscription and resource locks for critical resources
rules.description: Production resource groups or critical resources should document CanNotDelete or ReadOnly locks preventing accidental teardown.
rules.remediationGuidance: List lock strategy in governance.RequiredControls; reference lock resources from azureExtractor when present.

frameworkMappings.theme: CIS 2.3 — Resource locks on critical assets
